data.gender_notes: Amiri is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Belonging to a king or commander, noble, mighty, powerful, and just. The name Amiri carries the meaning “Prince, Commander, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Amiri usually hope their child will grow to embody prince, commander, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Amiri belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Prince, Commander, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Amiri total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hindi.name: अमीर

in_english.name: Amiri
in_english.meaning: Servant of the King, Leader of the Faithful, Bearer of the Banner of Islam
in_english.long_meaning: The name Amiri is derived from the Arabic root 'Amir', which means 'to command' or 'to rule'. It is one of the 99 names of Allah and is used to refer to a leader or a commander in Islam. In Arabic, the name is written as 'أمير' and is composed of three letters: 'Alif', 'Mim', and 'Raa'. The name has a rich history and is associated with many notable figures in Islamic history. It is also used as a given name for boys in many Muslim cultures. The name Amiri is a symbol of leadership, power, and wisdom, and is considered a noble and prestigious name in many Islamic societies.

The name "Amiri" can serve as a daily inspiration to embody the best of these spiritual qualities in thought, word, and deed.
